items.title_zh: MindAid 辅助型 SSVEP 脑机接口
bullets_zh: 实现基于 SSVEP 的辅助型 BCI，可从脑电信号实时选择基本需求。
利用非侵入式稳态视觉诱发电位（SSVEP）进行通信或控制。
适用于低成本辅助技术及消费级/科研 EEG 场景。
bullets_en: Implements an assistive SSVEP-based BCI that selects basic needs from EEG signals in real time.
Uses non-invasive steady-state visual evoked potentials (SSVEP) for communication or control.
Relevant to low-cost assistive technology and consumer/research EEG setups.
items.brief: 基于 SSVEP/EEG 的低成本辅助型 BCI，可实时选择基本需求。
items.brief_en: Low-cost assistive SSVEP/EEG BCI that selects basic needs in real time.
items.raw_excerpt: MindAid Assistive SSVEP BCI. Assistive SSVEP-based Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) for real-time selection of basic needs through EEG signals.

items.title_zh: Emotiv NeuroGame：Unity 脑电赛车游戏
items.title_en: Emotiv NeuroGame Unity EEG Racing Game
bullets_zh: 展示由 Emotiv EPOC X 脑电信号控制的 Unity 6 赛车游戏。
使用消费级非侵入式 EEG 头带，而非植入式设备。
可作为应用型 BCI 游戏的本科毕业设计教学示例。
bullets_en: Demonstrates a Unity 6 racing game controlled by Emotiv EPOC X EEG signals.
Uses a consumer non-invasive EEG headset rather than invasive implants.
Serves as an educational BEng thesis example for applied BCI gaming.
items.brief: 用 Emotiv EPOC X EEG 控制的 Unity 赛车游戏，适合消费级 BCI 教学演示。
items.brief_en: Unity racing game controlled by Emotiv EPOC X EEG, useful for consumer non-invasive BCI demos.
items.raw_excerpt: Brain-Computer Interface racing game in Unity 6, controlled via Emotiv EPOC X EEG signals. BEng thesis, LAB University of Applied Sciences.

items.title_zh: 用于非侵入式BCI的EEG-Deformer PyTorch实现
items.title_en: EEG-Deformer PyTorch Implementation for Non-Invasive BCI
bullets_zh: 提供用于从脑电信号解码心理状态的 EEG-Deformer 卷积 Transformer PyTorch 实现。
面向使用头皮脑电而非植入式设备的非侵入式 BCI 应用。
可作为脑电解码实验的开源基线或起点。
bullets_en: Provides a PyTorch implementation of the EEG-Deformer convolutional transformer for decoding mental states from EEG.
Targets non-invasive BCI applications using scalp-recorded EEG signals rather than implants.
Useful as an open-source baseline or starting point for EEG classification experiments.
items.brief: 开源 EEG-Deformer PyTorch 实现，便于非侵入式脑电解码研究。
items.brief_en: Open-source EEG-Deformer PyTorch implementation that supports non-invasive EEG decoding research.
items.raw_excerpt: Decode mental states from EEG signals using this PyTorch implementation of the EEG-Deformer convolutional transformer for brain-computer interfaces.

items.title_zh: 运动想象脑机接口资源：EEG数据集与工具箱
items.title_en: MI-BCI Resources: EEG Motor Imagery Datasets and Toolboxes
bullets_zh: 该 GitHub 仓库汇总用于运动想象脑机接口的公开 EEG 数据集与机器学习/深度学习工具箱。
它配套一篇关于从EEG信号到指令的机器学习流程综述论文。
可作为非侵入式运动想象脑机接口评测与流程比较的起点。
bullets_en: GitHub repository curates public EEG datasets and ML/DL toolboxes for motor imagery BCI.
It accompanies a review paper on machine-learning pipelines from EEG signals to commands.
Useful as a starting point for non-invasive MI-BCI benchmarking and pipeline comparison.
items.brief: 汇总运动想象EEG数据集与工具箱，便于非侵入式BCI评测。
items.brief_en: Curates motor-imagery EEG datasets and toolboxes for non-invasive BCI benchmarking.
items.raw_excerpt: A collection of publicly available EEG datasets and ML/DL toolboxes for Motor Imagery Brain-Computer Interfaces, accompanying the review paper "From EEG Signals to Commands: A Review of Machine Learning Pipelines in Motor Imagery Brain-Computer Interfaces." Please cite the original sources and our paper if you use them.

bullets_zh: 该 GitHub 项目实现了基于EEG的Unity游戏实时控制。
使用信号处理，结合CSP/LDA分类与LSL通信。
展示非侵入式消费级脑机接口在交互应用中的集成。
bullets_en: GitHub project implements real-time EEG-based control of a Unity game.
Uses signal processing with CSP/LDA classification and LSL communication.
Demonstrates non-invasive consumer-BCI integration for interactive applications.
items.brief: 展示用EEG实时控制Unity游戏，适合非侵入式交互开发。
items.brief_en: Shows real-time EEG control of Unity games using CSP/LDA and LSL.
items.raw_excerpt: EEG-based brain-computer interface for real-time Unity game control using signal processing, CSP/LDA classification and LSL communication.

items.title_en: Real-Time EEG BCI Engine in Rust/WASM
bullets_zh: 该 GitHub 项目提供高性能实时EEG信号处理引擎。
它基于Rust与WebAssembly构建，面向实时神经遥测工作负载。
包含用于可视化脑信号的三维神经遥测运行时。
bullets_en: GitHub project provides a high-performance real-time EEG signal processing engine.
It is built with Rust and WebAssembly for real-time neural telemetry workloads.
Includes a 3D neural telemetry runtime for visualizing brain signals.
items.brief: 提供Rust/WASM实时EEG处理与三维神经遥测，适合高级开发。
items.brief_en: Provides a high-performance real-time EEG processing engine with Rust, WASM and 3D telemetry.
items.raw_excerpt: High-performance real-time EEG signal processing engine in Rust and WebAssembly with 3D neural telemetry runtime

items.title_zh: ADS1299 核心 SDK：EEG/BCI 开源生态
items.title_en: ADS1299 Core SDK for EEG/BCI Ecosystem
bullets_zh: 开源ADS1299 EEG/BCI SDK，面向8-64通道，并提供MCU、SoC、DSP和FPGA参考包。
包含Verilog RTL以及PC/移动端/Linux集成与Python/MATLAB/R分析工作流。
可作为非侵入式EEG软硬件起点，用于BCI开发与验证。
bullets_en: Open-source ADS1299 EEG/BCI SDK targeting 8-64 channels with reference packages for MCUs, SoCs, DSPs and FPGAs.
Includes Verilog RTL plus PC/mobile/Linux integration and Python/MATLAB/R analysis workflows.
Useful as a non-invasive EEG hardware/software starting point for BCI development and validation.
items.brief: 开源ADS1299 EEG/BCI SDK，提供多通道硬件、固件与分析工作流。
items.brief_en: Open ADS1299 EEG/BCI SDK with multi-channel hardware, firmware, integration and analysis workflows.
items.raw_excerpt: Building the world’s largest and most comprehensive open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem — 8–64CH hardware, 200 MCU/SoC/DSP & FPGA target/reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, Python/MATLAB/R EEG analysis, BCI workflows, validation, education and research.

items.title_zh: Fazalr714/neurorvq-rs：纯 Rust 的 NeuroRVQ 推理项目
items.title_en: Fazalr714/neurorvq-rs: Pure-Rust NeuroRVQ inference for EEG/ECG/EMG signals
bullets_zh: GitHub项目Fazalr714/neurorvq-rs实现纯Rust的NeuroRVQ推理。
它使用Burn 0.20对EEG、ECG和EMG信号进行分词，且无Python依赖。
发布于2026-09-18；适合轻量级非侵入式生物信号/BCI预处理实验。
bullets_en: GitHub project Fazalr714/neurorvq-rs implements pure-Rust NeuroRVQ inference.
It targets EEG, ECG, and EMG signal tokenization using Burn 0.20 with zero Python dependencies.
Published 2026-09-18; useful for lightweight non-invasive biosignal/BCI preprocessing experiments.
items.brief: 纯Rust的NeuroRVQ推理项目，用于EEG/ECG/EMG信号分词。
items.brief_en: Pure-Rust NeuroRVQ inference project for tokenizing EEG, ECG, and EMG signals with Burn 0.20.
items.raw_excerpt: Build pure-Rust NeuroRVQ inference to tokenize EEG, ECG, and EMG signals with Burn 0.20 and zero Python dependencies
